head_commit.message:
nanoda: start again with 2, then 1 threads after an oom-kill (task be5e47b3)

Comparator d03acab and e3dcf30 hard-code num_threads 4 for nanoda. patches/comparator-nanoda-threads.patch (key comparator_nanoda_patches in tools.json and tools-v4.35.0.json) reads COMPARATOR_NANODA_THREADS and prints the count. inside.py sets it only from control/nanoda-threads.txt, written by the controller. After an oom-kill of the nanoda check with the build finished, verify() starts the unit again with 2, then 1 threads if the time left is at least the wall time of the killed attempt. Profile key nanoda_threads_start starts lower (maintainer smoke run). anthropic-tools.json and rc2 pins write no num_threads (one worker already); a chain runs no nanoda. The patch compiled on both pins (desktop, lake build comparator).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
